steps.title: Open a thread
steps.plain: Start a new piece of work. Think of it as opening a fresh page in a logbook: nothing has been claimed yet, and nothing is owed.

steps.title: Record a Feature
steps.plain: Add some code. Producing something is an implicit promise that it works, so the runtime immediately writes down a debt you now owe.

steps.title: Try to stabilize

steps.plain: Try to mark the code as finished. The runtime refuses, because you never showed that it works.

steps.title: Verify with a check that fails
steps.plain: Run a test that does not match the code. The attempt is written down, but it proves nothing, so the debt stays exactly where it was.

steps.title: Try to stabilize again

result.message: Artifact 597e864cfdd75b186e5e67557adbff7b696b17ea79dbe47a09ab99433dce2f37 has open floor-rigor verification obligations: 6f271d5858ada5244b37140b9b914b61f5fc655976a6bb6db4fd1badf8917bc3

steps.plain: Try to finish again. Still refused: running a test is not the same as passing one.

steps.title: Verify with a check that passes
steps.plain: Run a test that does match the code. Now there is real evidence, and the debt clears.

steps.title: Stabilize
steps.plain: Mark it finished. This is the same request that was refused twice - it works now only because the evidence exists.

steps.title: Take the evidence
steps.plain: Everything above went into a log that cannot be quietly edited. This is the proof it has not been.
